views.description: Unique offer detail views: each employee counts once per offer per local day.

claims.description: Claims accepted in the period, counted at accepted_at. Pending, rejected, expired and cancelled requests are not counted.

redemptions.description: Voucher uses a partner member or administrator confirmed in the period, counted at confirmed_at (not when the claim was made). Gross: a later reversal does not remove the original use.

period_start.description: First local date of the bucket (a Monday for weeks, the 1st for months). The first and last buckets count only dates inside start..end.
